title: indigo_mount_lx200: rename the ToupTek SH20 meridian offset to X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_OFFSET.OFFSET labelled "Meridian offset (degrees)"
description:
Owner request 2026-11-27, for the SH20 meridian flip offset added by ticket 4209a50f (merged today, not released):
1. Rename the property X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_LIMIT to X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_OFFSET and its item LIMIT to OFFSET, so it is X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_OFFSET.OFFSET. Rename the matching .driver identifiers (TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_LIMIT -> TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_OFFSET, its property/item macros and any helper or comment naming it) consistently.
2. Change the item label from "Offset past the meridian (° assumed, negative before it, undocumented)" to exactly "Meridian offset (degrees)". The property label ("Meridian flip offset"), range -15..15, step and behaviour stay unchanged.
Edit indigo_drivers/mount_lx200/indigo_mount_lx200.driver, regenerate the checked-in indigo_mount_lx200.c (.h/_main.c if they change) with the unchanged generator, bump the driver version. Update every reference: indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md (custom property list and SH20 paragraph; keep the statement that ToupTek has not documented unit, sign or range), indigo_drivers/mount_lx200/PROTOCOL.md, indigo_test/integration/test_mount_lx200_simulator.c and any other file in the repository (search with git grep / grep, excluding .factory2/archive). The ZWO AM X_ZWO_MERIDIAN_LIMIT stays unchanged. Run the touptek and zwo cases of test_mount_lx200_simulator and the full suite.

outcome.summary: Pass. Diff master...HEAD (dd5fa3764, no uncommitted changes) is only the rename X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_LIMIT.LIMIT -> X_TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_OFFSET.OFFSET (.driver identifiers, macros, private field, handler name, comments), the item label now exactly 'Meridian offset (degrees)', and version 93 -> 94 (DRIVER_VERSION 0x0300005D -> 0x0300005E). Property label 'Meridian flip offset', range -15..15, step 1, format and logic unchanged. git grep outside .factory2/archive (and grep of untracked files) finds no TOUPTEK_MERIDIAN_LIMIT, touptek_meridian_limit or old label. ZWO_MERIDIAN_LIMIT counts identical to master in docs, .driver, .c and test; no ZWO line changed. X_ prefix kept. Unchanged generator (indigo_tools has no diff) regenerates .c/.h/_main.c byte-identical. PROPERTIES.md list order stays alphabetical (MERIDIAN < MERIDIAN_OFFSET < SPEED_LIMIT), SH20 paragraph names OFFSET and still says ToupTek does not document unit, sign or range; PROTOCOL.md updated. git diff --check clean. Rebuilt test_mount_lx200_simulator in the worktree: INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER=touptek 26 PASS 0 FAIL, zwo 13 PASS 0 FAIL; test-clean run afterwards. No defects found.
